claims.statement: Collins, the Cast Iron Man, wrote that he would be ready at a St. Louis saloon to put up $50 to $100 to meet Annabury.
claims.excerpt: saloon, St. Louis, where I will be ready to put up

claims.statement: Collins invited Mr. Annabury's friends to make arrangements at Tom Allen's saloon on Saturday evening, August 20, 1870.
claims.excerpt: Saturday evening, August 20, 1870, at Tom. Alien’s.

notes: The Collins challenge to Annabury is between two other men; Allen is only the venue. The saloon name before 'saloon, St. Louis' is garbled, so only the Aug 20 venue is tied to Allen.
